messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy will probably not vanish completely, because law, encryption, and public pushback may preserve some private spaces, Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s seems extremely unlikely, since we still lack a reliable model of memory, identity, and subjective experience, Consciousness
Wireless Internet anywhere on our planet is likely in many populated areas, yet complete coverage is doubtful, Wireless
Transport becoming fully electric is likely for cars and small vehicles, but aviation, shipping, and remote machinery may remain partly non-electric, Transport
Climate change effects may become partly irreversible if warming continues, though mitigation and adaptation can reduce some harms, Climate
Money in coins and notes will likely decline, yet physical cash may survive in emergencies, poor regions, and informal markets, Money
Scientists may uncover important genetic secrets, but living for centuries or forever remains highly speculative, Scientists
